caption: sega's fare-chasing arcade at its pc peak - glitter oasis, crazy jumps and the off-duty system.
about: Crazy taxi 3: high roller (2002) is the pc chapter of sega's fare-chasing arcade: small apple and west coast maps return remastered, glitter oasis joins as the night city, and the crazy jump system turns every park job into a stunt. The off-duty meter, the crazy drift and the original of orange beach-buggy physics complete the loop that made the series an arcade landmark.
The windows build is off the current stores - sega's classic catalog lives elsewhere - so the archive route carries the taxi license.
